gst.summary: Australia's VAT-equivalent is GST, generally 10%. Registration threshold and what is GST-free are ATO questions.

facts.note: GST, not VAT. Confirm registration threshold on ato.gov.au.

payroll.summary: Australian payroll includes PAYG withholding and Superannuation Guarantee. Super is not optional pocket money.

facts.note: Super guarantee rate changes by statute. Read the payroll product or ATO, do not invent the percent.
